subject: Pilot wrap: ClearCart metrics + quick quote & approval
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@clearcart.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: eng@clearcart.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: ClearCart POC wrap — numbers and next steps (attachments)

Hi Tessa / Monica,

Great news from our side — we finished the 10-day POC this morning and wanted to send a quick recap. Overall the Redwood runtime behaved very predictably under a production-like replay and the results are strong:

- End-to-end 95th pct latency dropped by ~42% (from ~520ms to ~300ms) under our 75% load pattern.
- Token inference cost reduced by ~60% after applying the suggested batching + KV caching profile.
- Median throughput improved from 120 reqs/min to ~360 reqs/min (3x) for our 256-token average prompt.
- No stability incidents; sustained 48-hour run with autoscale events handled cleanly.

I've attached the POC summary PDF and the latency chart for your review (ClearCart_POC_results_20260118.pdf, clearcart_latency_chart.png). The engineering team also confirmed the model variant swap during peak hours worked as expected.

Next ask from our side: the product and partner pages team would love a short 1–2 sentence quote (and permission to use our name/logo) that we can include in a partner spotlight. If it's easier, we can do a 15-minute call to approve wording — whatever you prefer.

Thanks for the partnership — the results give us confidence to move to a small pilot in production.

—Alex Nguyen
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearCart
